scope: Explicit Nexus BLM compositions, distinct from sparse original observations

definitions.rationale: Nexus defensive assembly uses fixed base Nyame, Defending and Moonbeam with reviewed Mpaca/Khonsu. Does not rely on random Merlinic DT, Unity maximums or the source Terra staff. No effective DT-cap claim.

definitions.rationale: Nexus fixed Wicce +3 assembly substitutes reviewed staff/grip and Null Shawl. Base Src. No elemental spell tier, best-in-slot, damage or cap result.

definitions.rationale: Separate Dark Magic Stun context with fixed skill accessories and recast-aware haste-bearing equipment; not a Drain/Aspir potency loadout. No landing, recast cap or stun-lock guarantee.
